summary.tldr: Changes the National Housing Strategy Act to address homeless encampments on federal land, and to add more Indigenous involvement and reporting.
what_it_does: Requires the National Housing Strategy to include measures that prevent the removal of homeless encampments on federal land and identify alternatives after meaningful engagement with residents.
Requires the Strategy to include processes that keep Indigenous peoples involved in housing programs that affect them and in responses to homeless encampments, while respecting their rights.
Adds a requirement to consult provincial housing ministers and Indigenous organisations when setting those encampment measures and processes.
Expands reporting on the Strategy’s results, including success measures developed with Indigenous organisations and longitudinal data broken down by group.
Defines “federal land” and “homeless encampment” for the Act.
summary.background: The bill amends the National Housing Strategy Act, which sets out Canada’s National Housing Strategy and its reporting rules.
